verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence shows Lithic's Auth Rules engine has a separate event stream for digital wallet and merchant tokenization decisioning. That implies tokenization is a distinct flow developers can control at provisioning time. Nothing in the pack shows tokens as manageable objects, and no other item addresses the story. Missing for 10: a documented API to list or view network tokens per card, attribution of each token to its wallet or merchant token requestor, token lifecycle actions such as revoke, suspend or resume independent of the PAN, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
